subject: Demo invite showing incorrect local time — can we reconfirm the slot
body:
-----Original Message-----
From: Akira Tan <akira.t@zenfinance.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 02:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — invite shows 7:00AM (I thought I booked 11:00PM JST)

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the demo invite. I clicked the Calendly link on my laptop (Japan timezone) and selected 23:00 on Apr 6. Your confirmation email shows 7:00 AM on the calendar event — which looks like PST. My colleague also sees 23:00 on the Calendly page. Can you confirm what timezone will be on the meeting invite, and whether attendees in Tokyo will see the right local time? We don't want to join at the wrong hour.

Best,
Akira
Senior PM, Zen Finance

-----Reply from Priya Natarajan to Akira Tan, Apr 2, 07:03 JST-----
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Akira Tan <akira.t@zenfinance.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 07:03:12 +09:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — invite shows 7:00AM (I thought I booked 11:00PM JST)

Hi Akira — sorry for the confusion and thanks for flagging.

Short answer: the Calendly UI sometimes displays the slot in the browser-detected timezone while the generated .ics or Gmail event can default to the host account timezone (our Redwood demo account is set to US/Pacific). That mismatch causes what you're seeing. We should make sure the event itself is created with the explicit TZID and that your calendar import shows local time.

I'm looping in Marissa (demo ops) and Ben (calendly integration) so we can: 
- send you a corrected invite (.ics) with TZID=Asia/Tokyo,
- confirm what attendees will see when they accept, and
- add a short note to the Calendly landing page recommending manual timezone selection if needed.

I'm attaching a quick screenshot of how your Calendly page looked (thanks for including), and I'll follow up with a fixed calendar invite in the next 20 minutes.

Would you prefer we convert the slot to UTC offsets in the invite (e.g., 23:00 JST / 14:00 UTC) to make it explicit?

Thanks again — we'll fix this right away.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0123

Attachments: screenshots/zen_calendly_tz_label.png (image/png)

-----Forwarded message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 07:21:45 +09:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — invite shows 7:00AM (I thought I booked 11:00PM JST)

Thanks for looping us in — quick status: 
- I just exported an .ics from Calendly using the account that booked the event. The exported .ics had the DTSTART/DTEND in UTC (Z suffix) but no TZID parameter, so some calendar apps render it in the host timezone.
- Workaround: create a small, corrected .ics that sets DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Tokyo and include an X-APPLE-CALENDAR-COMPONENTS block for Apple devices. That resolves Mac/iPhone display issues.

Priya — I generated a corrected invite and attached redwood-demo-invite-corrected.ics. Please send that to Akira and include the explicit UTC offset in the subject line so attendees see both local and canonical times. Also add a 15-minute buffer slot as backup.

Marissa Cole
Demo Ops Lead | Redwood Inference

-----Quoted text from previous message-----
> From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>

> Subject: Re: Redwood demo — invite shows 7:00AM (I thought I booked 11:00PM JST)

> Hi Akira — sorry for the confusion and thanks for flagging...

-----Priya to Akira (final)-----
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Akira Tan <akira.t@zenfinance.com>, calendar-admin@zenfinance.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:42:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — invite shows 7:00AM (I thought I booked 11:00PM JST) — corrected invite attached

Hi Akira,

Thanks for your patience. I've attached a corrected invite (redwood-demo-invite-corrected.ics) that uses DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Tokyo and includes the UTC offset in the subject. Please accept this invite instead of the previous one. Details: 

- Event: Redwood Product Demo (45m)
- Local time (JST): Tue Apr 6, 23:00 — 23:45 (GMT+9)
- UTC: Tue Apr 6, 14:00 — 14:45 UTC
- Join link: https://redwood.app/join/meeting/abc123 (the link is the canonical join; calendar event only contains the link text)

If your calendar client still shows 07:00 for any attendee, please a) try the attached .ics import instead of the Calendly accept, or b) tell us the device/os (Windows Outlook, Google Calendar web, iPhone) and we'll produce a client-specific .ics.

As a preventative measure, Ben will add an explicit timezone selection step to the Calendly instructions and we'll update our demo-playbook to include backwards-compatible .ics generation.

Apologies again for the confusion. If you'd like an earlier slot to avoid the late hour, here are two alternates in JST: Apr 6, 09:00–09:45 or Apr 7, 14:00–14:45. Which works better?

Warmly,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
mobile: +81 90 5555 3333

Attachments: redwood-demo-invite-corrected.ics (text/calendar)
